story: Stage 3 featured an early three-man break with Paleni, Veistroffer and Urianstad Bugge gaining around 2:30. Bugge pushed for KOM points during the stage to retain his KOM classification lead. Enzo Paleni was just caught inside the final kilometre. A strong Ineos lead-out set up Sam Welsford’s sprint win over Tobias Lund Andresen and Lewis Bower, while Jay Vine kept the overall lead after being delayed by a late crash and receiving the winner’s time.
